signal: Pine V2.43 closed H1 Stoch5/3/3 strict threshold20/80; directional wick strictly outside completed NY Monday 1.618; NY Tue-Fri as default display; every glyph, no future excursion filter
entry: First same-side new EMA20/50 crossing with 5m close >= H1 confirmation and <= confirmation+24h; exact next5m open; cancel if original target already touched during wait or gap/end intervenes; existing same-side cloud state alone insufficient.
target: Nearest original Monday edge, fixed at entry; resting limit
fee_source: Owner current OKX Lv1 per-fill fee scenario applied to Binance historical prices
limitations: Independent overlapping trades and sumR are not a funded account return; no leverage, capacity or liquidation simulation.
Historical Binance USD-M registered universe (including delisted-history files when available) with OKX cost scenario, not OKX fill replication; all638 registered files attempted.
5m OHLC O-H-L-C hypothesis; adverse stop-first sensitivity retained.
Market fills assume5bp adverse slippage each; target maker2bp, market taker5bp; funding not modelled.
Data gaps and data-end outcomes censored rather than labelled profitable; seven-day expiration is a market close.
October28 is missing across the stored Binance extension; some symbols also lack October31. Data are not filled or redownloaded.
Historical periods have been studied before; chronological later segment is not a pristine holdout.
All fixed-stop candidates use common valid wick geometry admission so candidate comparisons share signal events.
24h wait lifetime is a fixed research assumption, not specified by the external author; original cloud stop not tested in this one-variable entry study.
Four stop comparisons are not four independent validations. Primary stop fixed20 inherited from prior earlier-period choice; all history has been studied.
Eventual-fill baseline subset is an explanatory ex-post selection, not an executable entry filter.
Random controls sample full historical month as a null benchmark only, never as strategy features.
Repeated H1 glyphs can share the same later cloud flip; independent overlapping positions retained and event counts must not be treated as independent samples.
baseline: Frozen original trade ledger reused; no baseline trade replay. Compare full baseline, descriptive eventual-fill subset, and delayed entries; shared completed pairs reported separately.
primary: fixed20 predetermined from earlier-period baseline study; all four original stop formulas retained as sensitivity, no new threshold search.
control: Three random5m opens, same symbol/entrymonth/latest closed H1 ATR14 log bucket, matching side and percentage stop/target distances. Pool requires complete Monday, nonstale H1, positive H1 volume and previous EMA warmup; not conditioned on cloud flips.
source_rule: Inspected Pine: Fast close EMA20 and Slow close EMA50 determine cloud; Medium parameter does not affect fill/color. Original supply/demand location replaced by frozen Monday1.618 H1 glyph setup.
